paragraphs: I'm excited to apply for the Software Engineer role at forml. Your work in redefining how businesses integrate and utilize AI/ML really caught my attention, especially your focus on building scalable backend solutions with Flask and Redis.

My core strengths lie in Python and systems-level development, focusing on creating secure, observable, and scalable software solutions. I am adept at working across cloud environments like AWS, Azure, and GCP, containerizing with Docker/Kubernetes, provisioning with Terraform, and implementing CI/CD pipelines to ensure all processes are testable, versioned, and easy to roll back.

In my previous role, I engineered a solution that consolidated diverse enterprise systems into a unified platform. This project reduced manual effort by over 100 hours per month and improved the organization's visibility and response capabilities across thousands of endpoints. My experience in automating end-to-end workflows from data aggregation to remediation has equipped me with the skills needed for your team.

I am comfortable owning the entire lifecycle of a solution, from design through deployment and operations. This includes architecting and implementing features, instrumenting pipelines, documenting APIs and system contracts, and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. I look forward to contributing my expertise in building reliable, secure, and scalable software that solves complex problems.
